title: Fiona’s Introduction
text:
Hello, my name is Fiona Herzog. I am an undergraduate student at the University of Pennsylvania with a double major in Computer Science & Communications with a concentration in Data & Network Science.
Some of my hobbies include baking (& eating bread), risoprinting, running, and traveling.

My favorite class I have taken is How to Make Things, where I got to make cool items like a 3D puzzle and end of year project of selling keychains.
Over this winter break, I got the opportunity to go to Taiwan to see my family. Thus, I got the opportunity to eat yummy fresh fruits, go shrimp fishing, and even learn how to glass blow.
While I have lost the ability to read books in full I am lucky to reach even just two books in a year, I am an avid reader of many articles. Coming from the Palisades, this article and exploration is particularly resonant to me. Speaking of which, I am from the greatest city in the world, Los Angeles. My winter break was plenty warm and I spent most of it sunbathing 𖤓
